dhp209:1: Engaging oneself in what is not suitable, not engaging in what is suitable,
dhp209:3: abandoning the good, grasping the loved, he envies the one who endeavours for himself.
dhp210:1: Do not associate at any time with those who are loved or with those unloved,
dhp210:3: there is suffering not meeting those loved, and (suffering from) meeting those unloved.
dhp211:1: Therefore do not hold (anything) as loved, for losing those who are loved is loathsome.
dhp211:3: There are no knots for those who hold nothing as loved or as unloved.
dhp212:2: From love there arises grief, from love there arises fear,
dhp212:4: for one who is free from love there is no grief, how is there fear?
dhp213:2: From fondness there arises grief, from fondness there arises fear,
dhp213:4: for one who is free from fondness there is no grief, how is there fear?
dhp214:2: From delight there arises grief, from delight there arises fear,
dhp214:4: for one who is free from delight there is no grief, how is there fear?
dhp215:2: From desire there arises grief, from desire there arises fear,
dhp215:4: for one who is free from desire there is no grief, how is there fear?
dhp216:2: From craving there arises grief, from craving there arises fear,
dhp216:3: for one who is free from craving there is no grief, how is there fear?
dhp217:2: Endowed with virtue and insight, principled, knowing the truths,
dhp217:3: doing the deeds that are his own, that one the people love.
dhp218:1: The one with desire arisen for the undeclared, will be suffused with the (awakening) mind,
dhp218:3: with a mind unconnected with sense pleasures, he is spoken of as ‘one gone upstream’.
dhp219:1: When one who lives abroad for a long time comes safely from afar,
dhp219:3: his relatives, friends and companions come and greatly rejoice.
dhp220:1: Just so, when one who has performed merit goes from this world unto the next,
dhp220:3: his merits are received just as relatives come to their loved one.
dhp220:5: The Chapter about Love, the Sixteenth
